name: Brachiosuchus
sum: Long-snouted dyrosaurid from the Late Cretaceous Kababish Formation of Sudan, possibly about 7 m long.
wsnote: Possible length around 7 m from body size estimates (Wikipedia).
holotype: MfN SUD001 to SUD012, cranial and postcranial material of a single individual.
material: The skull is about 1.5 m long and the snout makes up 67% of its length; four complete and several fragmentary osteoderms are preserved.
biology: Body size estimates suggest a possible length of around 7 m; the femur is 48 cm long and of typical dyrosaurid form.
author: Salih et al. 2022

sources.text: K. O. Salih, D. C. Evans, and R. Bussert, N. Klein, J. Müller. 2022. Brachiosuchus kababishensis, a new long-snouted dyrosaurid (Mesoeucrocodylia) from the Late Cretaceous of north central Sudan. Historical Biology 34:821-840
